ce_01_stray_semicolon_if_else.as - Stray semicolon immediately after if condition followed by else (EXPECT: accept)
ce_02_else_without_if.as - An else statement with no preceding if statement (EXPECT: reject)
ce_03_else_if_missing_condition.as - An else if clause missing its conditional expression (EXPECT: reject)
ce_04_nested_if_else_binding.as - Nested if statements with dangling else binding to the inner if (EXPECT: accept)
ce_05_else_inside_loop_body.as - An unattached else block placed directly inside a loop body (EXPECT: reject)
ce_06_long_valid_else_if_chain.as - A long valid chain of if, else if, and else branches (EXPECT: accept)
ce_07_else_if_int_condition.as - An else if chain where one branch condition is an int instead of bool (EXPECT: reject)
ce_08_else_if_undeclared_identifier.as - An else if branch condition naming an undeclared identifier (EXPECT: reject)
ce_09_else_if_assignment_condition.as - An else if condition using assignment instead of comparison (EXPECT: reject)
ce_10_else_if_wrong_return_type.as - An else if chain where the last else returns a value of the wrong type (EXPECT: reject)
ce_11_plain_valid_try_catch.as - A plain valid try-catch block (EXPECT: accept)
ce_12_try_catch_inside_loop.as - A valid try-catch block nested inside a for-loop body (EXPECT: accept)
ce_13_catch_without_try.as - A catch block without a preceding try block (EXPECT: reject)
ce_14_bad_condition_in_try.as - An if statement with an invalid int condition inside a try block (EXPECT: reject)
ce_15_return_in_try_and_catch.as - Return statements inside both try and catch blocks matching the function type (EXPECT: accept)
ce_16_for_condition_bool.as - A for-loop whose condition expression is a bool (EXPECT: accept)
ce_17_for_condition_int.as - A for-loop whose condition expression is an int (EXPECT: reject)
ce_18_for_condition_float.as - A for-loop whose condition expression is a float (EXPECT: reject)
ce_19_for_condition_string.as - A for-loop whose condition expression is a string (EXPECT: reject)
ce_20_for_condition_class_no_conv.as - A for-loop condition using a class instance without a boolean conversion operator (EXPECT: reject)
ce_21_for_init_global_int.as - A for-loop initializing a counter from a declared global int (EXPECT: accept)
ce_22_for_init_global_string_mismatch.as - A for-loop initializing an int counter from a global string causing a type mismatch (EXPECT: reject)
ce_23_for_init_two_variables.as - A for-loop init clause declaring two variables of the same type (EXPECT: accept)
ce_24_for_init_empty.as - A for-loop with an empty init clause and an existing counter variable (EXPECT: accept)
ce_25_for_init_float.as - A for-loop init clause declaring a float counter variable (EXPECT: accept)
ce_26_for_inc_postfix.as - A for-loop increment clause using postfix increment i++ (EXPECT: accept)
ce_27_for_inc_compound_assign.as - A for-loop increment clause using compound assignment i += 1 (EXPECT: accept)
ce_28_for_inc_assignment.as - A for-loop increment clause using reassignment i = i + 1 (EXPECT: accept)
ce_29_for_inc_bare_identifier.as - A for-loop increment clause containing a bare variable with no operator (EXPECT: accept)
ce_30_for_inc_function_call.as - A for-loop increment clause calling a function declared in the file (EXPECT: accept)
ce_31_while_valid_bool.as - A while loop using a valid boolean condition (EXPECT: accept)
ce_32_do_while_int_condition.as - A do-while loop with an int condition instead of bool (EXPECT: reject)
ce_33_while_function_call_bool.as - A while loop whose condition calls a function returning bool (EXPECT: accept)
ce_34_while_function_call_int.as - A while loop whose condition calls a function returning int (EXPECT: reject)
ce_35_while_assignment_condition.as - A while loop using an assignment expression as the condition (EXPECT: reject)
ce_36_switch_int_value.as - A switch statement switching on an integer expression (EXPECT: accept)
ce_37_switch_string_value.as - A switch statement switching on a string value (EXPECT: reject)
ce_38_switch_duplicate_case.as - A switch statement containing duplicate case constant labels (EXPECT: reject)
ce_39_switch_default_in_middle.as - A switch statement with a default label placed between case labels (EXPECT: accept)
ce_40_switch_nested_in_for_loop.as - A switch statement nested inside a for-loop body (EXPECT: accept)
